previous_development.limits: Lower-bound development accounting: excludes parent/coordinator conversation usage and native attempts without receipts. Not a billing total. Do not amortize as zero.
previous_development.recurring_cost_rule: Native task receipts include skill prompt, retrieval/tool calls and recovery. Report input and output separately, plus cached subset, wall time, local CPU and file storage.
previous_development.pricing: No monetary claim without applicable rates. Cached input is a subset, reasoning output is a subset; never add subsets twice.
previous_development.break_even: Only compute under explicit rates and positive per-task net benefit; unmetered setup costs prevent a complete break-even claim.

accounting_limits: All measured candidate attempts retained, including cost regressions; not a recurring-deployment aggregate
Parent and reviewer conversation tokens unavailable; full project total is a lower bound
Missing optional usage fields remain null; cached input and reasoning output are subsets, never added twice
Storage measured as file byte lengths, not disk allocation; remote compute and electricity unavailable
No monetary or break-even claim without actual rates and full overhead; latency from concurrent runs is descriptive
